invariants.rationale: The method iteration and multiple accesses to nodes require it to be non-null.
plusMinusWidth is used as an offset for icon drawing and is likely non-negative for layout correctness.
Indent is used for positioning and is expected to be non-negative to avoid drawing artifacts.
The method makes drawing calls using batch, so it must be non-null.
Drawing colors for batch.setColor expect color components and alpha in [0,1].
